items.reason: Gap 0 explicitly describes overlapping copies both passing the Set check and processing the event twice before the ID is recorded.
Gap 1 states that the deduplication key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and can be forged or changed independently of the signed body.
Gap 2 identifies that charge.refunded is sent by the provider but only refund.created has a handler, causing every refund to be dropped.
No gap relies on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
